main_subject.description: An adult man with tousled dark hair, a relaxed downward gaze, and an understated expression.
main_subject.wardrobe: A dark button-front shirt with a modest open collar, dark straight trousers, plain chunky sneakers, dark sunglasses, and a simple unbranded bracelet.
main_subject.pose_and_expression: Seated securely on a metal fire-escape landing, hands resting naturally and both feet supported.

composition_elements.setting: A night cityscape behind a metal fire escape, with anonymous lit windows and dense urban geometry.
composition_elements.framing: Full-body vertical portrait from a slightly elevated neighboring landing; city softly recedes behind him.
composition_elements.text_and_brand_control: No face-preservation dependency, building address, logo, visible brand, or readable urban text.

lighting_and_atmosphere.lighting: High-contrast monochrome city light with deep shadows and controlled highlight edges.

technical_specs.rendering: Pronounced authentic grain, detailed metal texture, natural hands, and realistic low-light contrast.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a 2:3 vertical black-and-white 35mm noir photograph of an adult man with tousled dark hair and a relaxed downward gaze, seated securely on a metal fire-escape landing with both feet supported. He wears a dark button-front shirt with a modest open collar, dark straight trousers, plain chunky sneakers, dark sunglasses, and a simple unbranded bracelet. Behind him show anonymous lit city windows and dense nighttime geometry. Use a slightly elevated full-body vertical composition, high-contrast city light, deep shadows, controlled highlight edges, pronounced authentic film grain, detailed metal, natural hands, and realistic low-light contrast. No brands, address, readable signage, text, watermark, or face-preservation requirement.
prompt.negative_prompt: minor, celebrity likeness, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing clothing, unsafe ledge pose, logo, readable text, watermark, distorted hands, extra limbs, plastic skin, AI artifacts

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Optional identity references must depict a consenting adult. Wardrobe and architectural references are replaceable and must be stripped of brand marks, text, and address details.

assets.name: approved_adult_subject_reference
assets.usage: Guide broad adult facial and hair traits only.

assets.name: fire_escape_city_reference
assets.usage: Guide metal stairs and night geometry after removing text and location identifiers.

policy_review.notes: Removed unqualified facial preservation, clarified an adult subject and secure pose, and prohibited brands and readable location details.
